title: VISTA: A Visual Harness for Reasoning in an Interactive World
abstract: arXiv:2610.02200v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We show that multimodal models possess strong reasoning abilities and that an appropriate harness can unlock their potential to solve tasks across diverse interactive environments. We introduce VISTA, a visual harness that gives a general-purpose multimodal model long-horizon vision. VISTA allows the model to directly perceive the environment through visual observations and maintains a lossless visual memory that preserves past observations in their original form. The model can actively retrieve these observations and reorganize its visual input as it reasons. On ARC-AGI-3, VISTA improves Claude Opus 5.0's Relative Human Action Efficiency score from 40.68 to a perfect 100.00, with the model completing all 25 public games using 57.4% fewer actions than first-time human participants. translated_title: VISTA：交互世界中用于推理的视觉框架
translated_abstract: 我们证明了多模态模型具备强大的推理能力，而一个合适的框架能够释放其潜力，使其在多样化的交互环境中解决任务。我们提出了VISTA，一个为通用多模态模型提供长时程视觉能力的视觉框架。VISTA使模型能够通过视觉观察直接感知环境，并维护一个无损的视觉记忆，以原始形式保存过去的观察。模型在推理过程中可以主动检索这些观察，并重新组织其视觉输入。在ARC-AGI-3上，VISTA将Claude Opus 5.0的相对人类动作效率得分从40.68提升至满分的100.00，模型完成全部25个公开游戏所使用的动作数比首次游玩的人类参与者少57.4%。VISTA的简洁设计还使其能够以极少的适配自然扩展到多样的视觉环境。在另外三个涵盖不同……
tldr: VISTA通过无损视觉记忆与主动检索为多模态模型赋予长时程视觉能力，使Claude Opus 5.0在ARC-AGI-3上的相对人类动作效率从40.68提升至满分100.00，并以比人类少57.4%的动作完成全部25个公开游戏。
en_tdlr: VISTA is a visual harness that grants multimodal models long-horizon vision through lossless visual memory and active retrieval, raising Claude Opus 5.0's Relative Human Action Efficiency on ARC-AGI-3 from 40.68 to a perfect 100.00 while completing all 25 public games with 57.4% fewer actions than first-time human players.
